name: Open User's Guide
description: Home → Settings → Guide & Tips, Health and Safety, and Other Information → User's Guide. Verified live via Remote Play preview.
notes:
Home → Settings (gear icon, top-right) → "Guide & Tips, Health and Safety, and Other Information" → User's Guide.

Verified live on real hardware via Remote Play (input + MJPEG preview, one step at a time) on FW 12.70 - not dead-reckoned:
  ps              -> Home
  up, cross       -> opens Settings directly (gear icon was already reachable/focused from Home's top-right strip; no extra navigation needed to reach it)
  up, up          -> from Settings' 3rd item (Network) up to the 1st item, "Guide & Tips, Health and Safety, and Other Information"
  cross           -> opens that submenu (left column: Guide and Tips / Health and Safety / Legal Information; right column starts on "User's Guide")
  right, cross    -> moves into the right column and opens User's Guide

Note: on a jailbroken console the User's Guide webview may be redirected to a local/hosted loader page instead of Sony's actual documentation (a common homebrew setup) - that's expected, not a sign this script landed wrong.

name: Restart PS5
description: Long-press PS to open the Power menu, then Restart PS5.
notes:
Holding PS for ~1500 ms opens the PS5 Power overlay, where the default highlighted option is "Enter Rest Mode". From there:
  one  down + cross  -> Restart PS5
  just       cross    -> Enter Rest Mode
  two  down + cross  -> Turn Off PS5
Tweak the `ps` hold duration or the `wait`s if your console reacts faster or slower - a hold that's too short just opens Control Center instead of the Power overlay.
script:
ps 1500
wait 800
down
wait 400
cross
wait 2000
